hero.description: Blue Lagoon 4 is best understood as one option in Vang Vieng's west-bank lagoon network: a paid countryside water stop whose value depends on the day's road, water and crowd conditions.
steps: Arrive with swimwear and dry storage
Confirm facilities before paying for extras
Keep the return ride inside daylight
hero.rhythmNote: Do not chase lagoon numbers for their own sake. Pick one that fits your route and use it as a real pause between the karst roads, not another location to collect.

time.secondary: best combined with a west-bank ride

chapters.label: THE ROUTE
chapters.title: The lagoon should fit the loop, not dictate it
chapters.body: Blue Lagoon 4 is most useful when it sits naturally inside a ride through the western karst roads. That makes the day resilient: if the lagoon is busy or current facilities are not what you expected, the countryside still carries the outing.

note.label: ATLAS NOTE
note.text: Choose one lagoon well and stay. Three rushed lagoon stops rarely make a better day.

items.label: Time
items.detail: Include the road, swimming and a relaxed stop rather than counting only time in the water.

items.label: Access
items.detail: Check current route and surface conditions, especially in the wet season.

items.label: What to bring
items.detail: Protect phone, documents and cash from water and sudden rain.

items.label: Entry
items.detail: Confirm the current entrance and any optional activity fees locally.

faq.question: What is Blue Lagoon 4?
faq.answer: It is one of the separate numbered lagoon stops in the countryside west of Vang Vieng.

faq.question: Is Blue Lagoon 4 better than Blue Lagoon 3?
faq.answer: There is no fixed winner. Current crowd levels, road conditions, water and facilities matter more than the number.

faq.question: How long should I plan?
faq.answer: A half-day works well if the lagoon is part of a west-bank countryside ride.

faq.question: Can facilities change?
faq.answer: Yes. Numbered lagoon sites can change activities and amenities, so confirm the current setup on arrival.
